name: Shailesh Singh
title: Technology Lead
summary: Seasoned Technology Lead with 11+ years of experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Node.js. Proven expertise in architecting and migrating monolithic applications to distributed microservices and micro-frontend architectures. Domain experience spans BFSI, Telecom, Education, and Testing. Possesses an AI-first mindset for troubleshooting, brainstorming, and driving technical innovation.

experience.description: Led cross-functional teams to deliver complex BFSI technology projects on schedule. Mentored junior developers and expanded technical stack by mastering Node.js and React. Spearheaded the integration of multiple critical systems, including JMBR, Emirates Post, Cars24 loan system, WbEdge, WbCDD, Customer Portal, 4x Precious Metals, and the MacroHedge application.

Cultivated strong client relationships through proactive communication and problem-solving. Modernized legacy infrastructure by migrating all Perl batch jobs to Python. Engineered regulatory reporting solutions based on predefined templates for EMEA, APAC, and NA regions.

Drove technical strategy during product planning sessions, ensuring alignment with overarching business objectives. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to architect and design innovative software solutions.

Consistently delivered projects ahead of schedule through effective prioritization and resource management. Initiated and executed load testing protocols, successfully upgrading a monolithic web application in the production environment within a tight timeframe.
Collaborated with backend microservices teams to deliver high-quality, maintainable software products and implemented robust monitoring solutions across the product suite.
